primary_dropout_design.name: reference_immune_all_dropout
primary_dropout_design.definition: remove all immune-related labels from the scRNA reference

size_matched_control_dropout_design.name: reference_immune_size_matched_nonimmune_dropout_control

size_matched_control_dropout_design.notes: Label-level non-immune control cannot size-match the immune-all dropout within the 0.8-1.25 ratio; manual decision or a later cell-level control design is required.
